issues.on_page: State Receipts: State Aid 12,212.00 in the ENTERPRISE FUND column
issues.issue: Recorded as printed (Enterprise column total 96,594 includes it), but state aid in a utility fund is unusual and FY2023/FY2024 print it in the Fire Fund; may be a column misplacement in the filing. Also applies to detail[17].

County treasurer balance printed below the statement is not in the balance sheet; it is outside the line 28 totals (274,109), so exclusion is defensible, but the rules treat cash with county treasurer as Cash and Cash Equivalents.
